## What's Changed
* perf(gbuild): trust the plan — lean reviews, tiered gates, batched reviewers by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/24


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/compare/gbuild-v0.11.1...gbuild-v0.12.0

## What's Changed
* gbuild 0.1.1: plan charts onto its own branch by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/2
* gbuild 0.2.0: add gbuild:pr and gbuild:review, wire run → review → pr by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/3
* feat(gbuild): add OpenCode plugin target by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/4
* fix(gbuild): distribute OpenCode plugin via npm by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/5
* feat(gbuild): move plan to .gbuild/<feature>/db/ for CypherLite interop by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/6
* feat(gbuild)!: go all-in on Cypher — one CypherLite store per feature by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/7
* perf(gbuild): lean store reads — two cypherlite calls per wave by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/8
* perf(gbuild): slim per-node review to a fast gate by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/9
* feat(gbuild): run wave nodes in isolated git worktrees by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/10
* feat(gbuild): catch missed abstractions in node review by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/11
* feat(gbuild): isolate feature branch in its own worktree by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/12
* fix(gbuild): port to cypherlite 0.12.0 CLI (query verb + --database) by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/13
* refactor(gbuild): store is machine-local at <git-common-dir>/gbuild/<slug>/db by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/14
* perf(gbuild): pass slugs not content, dataflow scheduling, shared notes by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/15
* fix(gbuild): plan keeps file writes out of research/decision/verify nodes by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/16
* feat(gbuild): add the /gbuild:design phase before plan by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/17
* feat(gbuild): /gbuild:pr opens drafts and never flips ready by @jexp in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/18
* chore(gbuild): release 0.10.1 by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/19
* feat(gbuild): steer impls to the bar, trim gates by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/21
* feat(gbuild): add /gbuild:cleanup to reclaim a feature's local footprint by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/20
* feat(gbuild): add dispatch-driven release action by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/22
* fix(gbuild): non-fatal cypherlite install in the release workflow by @oskarhane in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/23

## New Contributors
* @oskarhane made their first contribution in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/2
* @jexp made their first contribution in https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/pull/18

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/oskarhane/oskars.ai/commits/gbuild-v0.11.1
